_readme: Big events in and around Turin, shown on app/turin-events.html. Edit on GitHub and commit. Past events hide themselves. confirmed:false shows 'Dates not confirmed yet' until you update the dates and set it to true. kind: food | art | music | sport | film | books | city.

events.title: Terra Madre Salone del Gusto
events.where: City centre, Piazza Carlo Felice to Piazza Vittorio
events.note: Slow Food's world food fair, free in the streets this year. Every two years.

events.title: Graphic Days
events.note: Visual design festival, spreading across the city on 22–23 October.

events.title: Luci d'Artista
events.note: Light artworks in the streets and squares every evening. Last year: 24 October to 11 January.

events.title: Paratissima
events.note: Independent art fair, the young side of Artissima weekend.

events.title: Nitto ATP Finals
events.note: The world's top eight tennis players.

events.title: Torino Film Festival
events.where: Cinemas across the city, opening at Teatro Regio
events.note: 44th edition, with a Marilyn Monroe retrospective.

events.title: Torino City Marathon
events.note: Marathon, half marathon and a 5 km fun run open to everyone. Central roads close in the morning.

events.title: CioccolaTò
events.note: Chocolate festival, Belgium as guest country. 10 February is for trade only.

events.title: Salone del Libro
events.note: Italy's biggest book fair. Catalan literature is the guest of honour.

events.title: Festa di San Giovanni
events.note: Turin's patron saint's day and a local holiday, with celebrations along the river.

events.title: Flowers Festival
events.note: Summer concerts in the Certosa park. Last year: 25 June to 17 July.
